Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a premium high-fidelity mobile UI concept board for a metronome's Division picker. This is a design proposal, not an implemented screen. Use the attached real app screenshot ONLY as MATERIAL / DESIGN LANGUAGE reference: warm ivory matte housing, subtle fine grain, beautifully crafted softly raised cream hardware keys with light rims and restrained shadows, graphite ink, recessed warm gray LCD-like wells, small restrained amber indicator on selected rhythm. Modern vintage music instrument, understated expensive industrial design, tasteful and clean, not steampunk, not shiny gold, not retro clutter. Modern readable Chinese sans-serif labels with occasional small instrument typography. Beautiful proportions, breathable title spacing, align precisely. All stateful selections have unmistakable charcoal inset surfaces with pale text. No dropdowns, no down chevrons for category menus, no additional decorative screens, no pointless help text, no per-card speaker icons. Bottom persistent playback strip: 96 BPM at left and large graphite Play key at right. Header 6:27 with full phone signal, WiFi, battery; title “细分” and square cream X close key. Cards show short engraved rhythm notation in black, no staff, musically plausible joined stems, beams, tuplet number 3 centered above relevant notes. Minimize words. Show two flat, straight-on portrait phone UI panels side by side on a neutral warm ivory board, no perspective mockup, no thick black phone frame, same dimensions, plenty of detail. Small letter and concept title outside phone screens, never within UI. Under each screen a short Chinese state caption. Design only the hierarchy and content described below. No English marketing slogans.
CONCEPT A “A · 双模式，实体选台”. Left screen shows 均分 selected, right screen shows 节奏型 selected. At top below title ONE premium 2-position hardware rocker labeled “均分” and “节奏型”, bold charcoal on selected half. It sits outside and above a separate recessed content tray with clear physical separation. LEFT tray contains 2-column 4-row compact square rhythm keys for 1 through 8 equal clicks per beat with tiny gray captions 1拍1下 ... 1拍8下, readable note group graphics; third is selected amber. RIGHT tray starts with THREE SMALL SEPARATE SQUARE-ISH KEYCAPS side by side labeled “八分”, “三连音”, “十六分”; these are physical preset buttons inside the tray rather than another segmented tab pill. Middle selected charcoal. Below these, a 2x3 grid of equally sized almost square rhythm keys showing triplet variations with rests and long-short notes. Main mode control visually larger and distinct from inner family keys; no underline tab design. Both screens a separate “自定义节奏” cream key with pencil below the tray then playback strip. This is closest to existing instrument, refined tactility and hierarchy. Captions “均分” and “节奏型 · 三连音”.

CONCEPT B “B · 一张节奏目录”. Remove tabs entirely, NO two-mode top toggle, NO stacked category bars. Single vertical scrolling score catalog organized under printed section headings and fine dividers. Left panel scroll position at start: prominent heading “均分”, 2-column by 4-row rhythm key grid for 1–8 even subdivisions, then section divider and heading “节奏型” at bottom with the beginning of three direct category shortcut keys “八分” “三连音” “十六分”. Right panel shows the SAME catalog scrolled to patterns: printed overarching heading “节奏型”; three direct shortcut keys horizontally “八分” “三连音” “十六分” serve as scroll-to-section anchors, not content hiding tabs. Below show section heading “八分” with 2 equal square rhythm keys, then “三连音” with 2x2 equal square rhythm keys, and a glimpse of next heading “十六分” to communicate vertical continuation. The content is grouped by shared shallow recessed trays, clear headings and whitespace, not nested containers everywhere. No dropdown, no invisible sections; selected musical pattern amber lamp. A small pencil hardware action “自定义” near title, keeping playback fixed at bottom. Right panel visible scroll indicator subtle. Catalog calm, spacious, practical and elegant; same real app cream hardware language. Captions “从均分开始” and “向下看节奏型”.

CONCEPT C “C · 侧边索引”. Remove all horizontal tabs. Single spatial hierarchy with a narrow integrated LEFT navigation rail, right content tray. About 25% width rail, 75% right. Rail has a standalone raised category key “均分”; then a non-clickable small gray group label “节奏型” with three stacked compact raised keys “八分”, “三连音”, “十六分” underneath clearly indented. Thin groove separates rail from notation tray. Exactly one selected navigation key charcoal. Left screen 均分 selected, right screen 三连音 selected. RIGHT content panel always 2-column near-square rhythm keys: left 8 even choices, right 6 triplet pattern choices. Show clean small notation on both with consistent fine engraving and restrained amber current-value lamp; no labels above rail duplicating current selection, no dropdown, no top even/pattern tabs, no tiny narrow sidebar wording; use readable Chinese. Whole browser is one crafted recessed instrument module, rail keys physically smaller and hierarchy carried by alignment/group spacing; the view should be fresh, modern, meticulously designed rather than an enterprise dashboard sidebar. Separate “自定义节奏” physical key below module, playback fixed bottom. Captions “均分” and “节奏型 · 三连音”.
refinements: Edit this UI concept board narrowly. Preserve all layout, warm ivory physical controls, titles, right panel catalog structure, typography and backgrounds. Correct LEFT panel's 8 even subdivision cards to 1 through 8, row-major. Captions exactly: '1 / 拍', '2 / 拍', '3 / 拍', '4 / 拍', '5 / 拍', '6 / 拍', '7 / 拍', '8 / 拍'. No parentheses. First card one quarter note, second two beamed eighth notes, third three beamed eighth notes with numeral 3 above, fourth four beamed sixteenth notes, fifth five sixteenth notes marked5, sixth six sixteenth marked6, seventh seven sixteenth marked7, eighth eight thirty-second notes. Each card describes ONE quarter-note beat. Keep exact 8 cards and selected first lamp. On right retain section layout and three direct shortcut keys, correct eighths examples to quarter-beat duration patterns of eighth rest + eighth note, and eighth note + eighth rest. Rhythm drawing placeholders only but strive for coherent notation. Do not add explanatory text.

Refine this exact UI design board. Keep BOTH phone panels, left navigation rails unchanged, all materials and typography, top header and bottom controls. Critical change: content must NOT show 16 tiny rectangular tiles per phone. LEFT phone right-content area: EXACTLY EIGHT larger approximately square keys in TWO columns and FOUR rows, showing even 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 subdivisions row-major. No mixed patterns in this even screen. Use notation and small gray captions '1 / 拍' through '8 / 拍'. RIGHT phone right-content area: EXACTLY SIX larger square keys in TWO columns and THREE rows, depicting triplet patterns with rests or mixed long-short notes, each within one quarter-note beat, numeral3 above each. Six pattern examples: quarter+eighth, eighth+quarter, eighth-rest+two-eighths, eighth+eighth-rest+eighth, two-eighths+eighth-rest, two-eighth-rests+eighth. Need clear right content larger and readable, elegant spacing. Do not duplicate left and right card content. LEFT sidebar 均分 selected charcoal, RIGHT sidebar 三连音 selected charcoal. No dropdown, no tabs across top, no extra rows added. Reduce empty bottom area by gently adjusting overall module height while maintaining consistent shared overall phone dimensions. This is tactile refined vintage hardware, not tiny dense software controls.
